messages:
Ibrahim: Quick sync from the perf run 1: lots of variance in which layers cause tails during cold hotstart. Thinking out loud: instead of static priority tags, what about a small per-shard "warmup_score" that loader uses to rank warmup order?
Nina: +1. A numeric score lets runtime combine static hints with live signals (recent_access_rate, avg_latency, kvcache_hit_prob).
Priya: Agree. Proposal: manifest adds optional warmup_score (float 0..1) and min_prefetch_bytes. Loaders compute effective_score = alpha*warmup_score + beta*live_signal and sort.
Jules: Live_signal sources? We can use arrival_histogram (recent 1m) for token prefixes, and a small predictive model that maps prefix->layer_importance. Keep it simple initially: recent_access_weight and failure_penalty if layer causes stalls.
Ibrahim: Example manifest line (sketch, loader ignores unknown fields):
```text
shard: model.safetensors.003, warmup_score:0.8, min_prefetch_bytes:131072, uncompressed_size_hint:524288
```
Nina: Important: warmup_score must be advisory only. When eviction pressure is high, we still need eviction-aware heuristics. Suggest adding a per-shard soft_expiry_ms so loaders can age out scores for very old manifests.
Priya: Also, for micro-shards (many tiny files) warmup ordering must consider consolidation cost. Add "concat_cost_hint" (small|medium|large) so scheduler can decide to batch these together rather than interleave.
Jules: Good point. And quantized shards should expose "dequant_cpu_cost" so the token bucket or worker pool can account for CPU when scheduling warmup (we shouldn't overload CPU-heavy dequant on same host as inference threads).
Ibrahim: Telemetry we need: warmup.ordering.chosen_score, warmup.prefetch.bytes, warmup.result (hit|fallback|timeout), and a per-shard stall_count. ops-bot can you make a ticket?
ops-bot: Created INF-8088: "warmup_score telemetry". Metrics: shard.warmup.effective_score, shard.warmup.prefetch_bytes, shard.warmup.result, shard.warmup.stall_count.
Nina: Concurrency: loader should expose a configurable scoring policy: alpha/beta tuning and a bounded warmup_worker_pool. Default alpha=0.7 (manifest bias), beta=0.3 (live bias). We'll surface via config flags.
Priya: For safety, default warmup_score=0.5 if absent. loader must fall back to existing FIFO warmup when scoring disabled.
Jules: Experiment idea: run A/B where A uses static priority tags and B uses adaptive scoring. Measure p50/p95 cold-start and overall prefetch bytes. Share sims in this thread.
Ibrahim: Action items: Nina draft manifest additions + defaults; Priya add concat_cost_hint and dequant_cpu_cost fields to loader planning; Jules prototype scoring aggregator + sim; ops-bot will track INF-8088.
Priya: I'll also add a small note for ops: when shipping models with many micro-shards, recommend setting concat_cost_hint=large or producing a concatenated origin.
Nina: I'll open the RFC PR tonight with examples and a tiny YAML->manifest mapping doc.
Ibrahim: Great, thanks. If anyone wants to pair on the scoring sim ping me. :thumbsup:
